# raff_permissions (Data Source)

Reads the read-only permission catalog. Use the `name` field as a permission identifier on `raff_role`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `scope` (String) Filter by scope: `account` or `project`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `permissions` (List of Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permissions))

- `description` (String)
